description: Estimate whether an AkulaCyber order placed now ships today and between which dates Nova Poshta usually delivers it, from the current time in Kyiv and the store's same-day cut-off: 17:30 Monday to Friday, 16:30 on Saturday and Sunday. Use it when the user asks when an order would ship or arrive; for delivery points use akulacyber_find_delivery_points, and for delivery cost and payment methods akulacyber_get_store_policy. Delivery usually takes 1 to 3 days after shipping; dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Public holidays are not known to it, and orders paid by bank transfer ship only once the money arrives.
